items.title: Lawrence Trotter Interview, 1966-01-13
items.q: Isidore Crump was one of them [in the band].

ctx.x: Oh, yeah. I never ever heard him play trumpet. I don't know. Maybe once or twice when he was playing bass with Thomas or something.
And Crump, Isidore Crump, he met him.
No, I never have met him.
